name: Aged Kodo Hide
summary: Aged Kodo Hide comes from aged kodos in Desolace. Kreldig Ungor needs three hides for Reclaimers Inc., alongside Scorpashi venom.

sections.title: A Kodo Reagent
sections.body: Kreldig Ungor needs three Aged Kodo Hides in Desolace, as well as seven vials of Scorpashi venom. The hide must come from an aged kodo; dying and ancient kodos do not provide the reagent.

faq.q: Where do Aged Kodo Hides come from?
faq.answer: Aged Kodo Hides come from aged kodos in Desolace.
Kreldig Ungor needs three Aged Kodo Hides for Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.

faq.q: Will any kodo provide the hide?
faq.answer: No. The hide must come from an aged kodo, not a dying or ancient kodo.
Kreldig also needs seven vials of Scorpashi Venom.

angles.text: As a mage, you may recognize Aged Kodo Hide as one of the reagents on Leftwitch's list for Reclaimers Inc.
